race.comment: CAT CALL (10) loves it here on the Poly surface only missing a drum once from seven outings. Gets in very well at the weights with the 3kg claim and another bold showing is expected. MISSILE ONE (8) returned in fine fashion with a solid Sunny Coast victory and will have taken some confidence from that win. Can go back-to-back without surprising. MISHANI EGO (6) has been plying her trade in town of late and will appreciate the drop back in company here. Watch for sharp improvement. SURFERS ROYALE (7) is a four-time winner over this distance range and strips fitter third-up from the break. In the mix. SPIRIT OF BRODIE (2) rounds out the selections.
